activation_boundary: User approval authorized implementation of the four proposed improvement stages. The bounded software protocol below has been executed; this does not establish independent semantic-label validity, the original inferential analysis, or real-home outcomes.

authorization.scope: Implement the proposed E1 end-to-end benchmark, semantic/control reliability fixes, observed role contributions, and decision replay UI.

episode_unit.definition: One fresh SmartHomeEnvironment, one user command, optional pre-context, one configured method, one repeat seed, and one fixed post-control evaluation horizon.
episode_unit.repeat_interpretation: Repeat seeds are repeated measurements for stability, not independent task population members.

target_design.unique_episode_count_interpretation: Compatibility field: 600 configured episodes drawn from 24 developer-authored base scenarios, not 600 independent tasks or population samples.
target_design.minimum_smoke_contract: At least one deterministic smoke runner must emit schema, method, task_id, repeat_seed, semantic provenance, state fingerprint, final-state metrics, action-change traces, and claim boundary before full runs.

controls.description: Semantic, planning, execution, and feedback without multi-agent safety/critic review or preference adaptation.
Center-orchestrated multi-agent review without personalized planning context.
Preference-adapted planning with current explicit profile, but without treating unconfirmed experience as a planning prior.
Preference-adapted planning with safety review, critic review, feedback loop, and only user-confirmed experience exposed as planning context.

statistical_plan.primary_comparison: candidate_method_minus_single_agent within matched task_id, repeat_seed, condition, semantic backend, and initial_state_fingerprint
statistical_plan.multiple_comparison_policy: Holm correction across primary method comparisons
statistical_plan.minimum_reporting: Report descriptive effects even when task clusters are insufficient; do not label them as significance tests.

implemented_protocol.matched_controls: Fresh isolated environment per run; common initial-state fingerprint, configuration, condition, disturbance seed, semantic backend, provenance, and evaluation horizon across methods.
implemented_protocol.outcome_verification: Developer-authored declarative device/room predicates evaluated independently of TaskRunner's success flag on the immediate and post-step final states. final_state_success means developer state-contract pass rate, not complete user-intent or safety achievement; E1-022 to E1-024 have partial temperature-only outcome coverage. runtime_success is separate.
implemented_protocol.simulator_accounting_boundary: The post-control 30-minute kWh value is a single-step endpoint-power estimate. Action batches additionally apply a five-minute temperature/humidity relaxation without matching clock or energy accounting. The measurement does not represent equal total physical duration across methods, integrated physical energy, or complete control cost.
implemented_protocol.statistical_analysis: Descriptive paired effects with base_task_id cluster bootstrap; configuration variants and repeat seeds stay in their base-scenario cluster.
metric_boundaries: Semantic accuracy uses developer-authored intent references without independent review.
Device selection F1 applies only to explicit device-state predicates; scenes without such predicates are N/A.
Humidity/ventilation tasks verify actuator states, not achievement of ambient humidity targets.
final_state_success reports only the declared developer state contract; unasserted intent, personalization benefits, and safety properties remain outside that metric.
Request latency measures the timed TaskRunner call and excludes earlier scripted feedback training.
Longitudinal context uses scripted feedback and isolated simulated histories, not real resident feedback.
RAG conditions use isolated lexical knowledge fixtures, not a measured real prompt-injection distribution.

completed_artifacts.provenance_note: Historical completed full matrix; source and fixture hashes describe the code and state predicates at generation. Later control fixes and predicate coverage changes prevent attributing cross-version differences to the control fix alone.

Completed post-fix smoke only; it does not stand in for a post-fix full matrix. Later predicate coverage changes must remain tied to new fixture hashes; different source, fixture, or matrix versions are not a matched estimate of the fix effect.

Final full run under frozen e1_episode_tasks_v2 and recorded source manifest. This ledger entry was added after the run; frozen_spec.json preserves the executed protocol. Do not attribute differences from historical artifacts to the control fix alone.

supported_thesis_wording: The executed mock TaskRunner benchmark supports descriptive method tradeoffs within 24 developer-authored base scenarios and their matched software-simulation configurations, tied to each artifact's frozen source and protocol hashes.
prohibited_thesis_wording: The configured episodes or repeat seeds are independent population samples; the original mixed-effects/Holm plan has been executed; the artifacts prove model generalization, real-home safety, real resident satisfaction, or universal multi-agent superiority.
